title: Cartridge: 133 16-bit RPG World Sounds and BGS Loops
shortText: 133 retro RPG world sounds: 33 BGS loops, chests, doors, creatures.
html:
Cartridge is 133 retro RPG world sound effects and background loops for RPG Maker MZ and MV, Godot, Unity, GameMaker and any engine.

33 of them are seamless BGS loops with the loop tags RPG Maker reads, so Play BGS loops them with no plugin. A free demo of 12 sounds is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_a_map.gif@@

What is inside

133 sounds · 33 seamless loops · 10 whole mechanisms · WAV + OGG · 12 sound free demo

  • Weather (14 files, 9 loops): rain at three strengths, a storm, wind from plains to blizzard, snow, desert wind, thunder.
  • Nature and water (17, 9 loops): forest birds, insects, crickets, frogs, a swamp, a river, a waterfall, a shore, a spring.
  • Caves and dungeons (15, 6 loops): cave drips, lava, a dungeon hum, a sewer, an ice cavern, a haunted manor, torches, chains.
  • Towns and interiors (9, 7 loops): a town square, a tavern, a castle hall, a campfire, a hearth, a ship, a windmill.
  • Chests and doors (20): three chests and two doors that open, close or rattle locked, a gate, a key.
  • Switches and secrets (15): levers, switches, plates, a push block, secret passages, a warp, a healing spring.
  • Terrain and travel (20): bushes, grass, splashes, ladders, stairs, ice, mud, a rope bridge.
  • Creatures (23): yells and footfalls in four sizes, a boss roar, slimes, bats, a ghost.

@@IMG:shot_1_the_world_map.png@@

@@IMG:shot_3_the_chain.png@@

One modelled 16 bit console chain makes every file: a 22 sample instrument bank in a 4 bit block code (32,256 bytes), Gaussian interpolation, a noise generator, at most 5 voices at once, an echo unit, out at 32,000 Hz.

Works with

RPG Maker MZ and MV, Godot 4, Unity, Unreal, GameMaker and HTML5: use the OGG or WAV files directly. Loop points are written into every loop file. Import notes are in the readme.

Try it free

The demo holds rain, forest, cave and town loops, a chest, a door and a monster.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code: no generative audio model, samples or recordings. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. There is no music and there are no voices; battle, menu and spell sounds are not in this pack.

More from the same studio

  • Overdub II: RPG Maker MZ Event Sounds and BGS, the engine's own event file names, modern voice.
  • Portcullis: Dungeon Mechanisms, doors, chests and traps, full fidelity.
  • Creature Vocal Forge: Monster Voice Sets, monsters with every state.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
